data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 暖意客厅的鲷鱼烧投喂
data.description: 冬日黄昏的卫宫家日式客厅内，暖桌散发着融融暖意。阿尔托莉雅身着整洁的白色衬衫与深蓝百褶裙，双手捧着刚出炉的金黄红豆鲷鱼烧，小口吹了吹热气，微红着双颊递向少年：“士郎，刚烤好的……分你一半。”
data.location: cozy traditional Japanese living room with warm kotatsu and tatami floor
data.action: sitting kneeling at kotatsu table, holding a steaming golden taiyaki pastry with both hands, blowing gently on it, blushing cheeks, earnest adoring green eyes
data.lighting: warm amber indoor lamp glow blending with soft dusk window light
data.mood: wholesome heartwarming domestic date, adorable gluttonous girlfriend sweetness, peaceful winter comfort
data.promptProse: Sitting at a warm kotatsu table in a traditional living room at dusk, blonde saber Artoria in her casual shirt and skirt blows gently on a steaming golden taiyaki, blushing as she offers a bite with earnest affection.
data.animaCaption: Blowing gently on a steaming golden taiyaki at the warm kotatsu table, she offers a bite with an earnest blushing smile.
